series.name: 7 things nobody tells you before your first time
series.label: Nobody tells you this · 2 of 7

beats.vo: The most underrated move your first time is going slower than feels natural.
beats.visual_intent: Water drop falling into water, slow motion, dark background.

beats.vo: Nerves make you rush. You want to get to the part you're worried about so it's over with. But rushing is what makes it feel mechanical, for both of you.
beats.visual_intent: Train passing fast at night, motion blur, no people.

beats.vo: Slow down the kissing. Slow down everything before anything else happens.
beats.visual_intent: Leaves moving gently in a breeze, golden hour.

beats.vo: Going slow keeps you present instead of stuck in your head.
Number one is next: the one thing to remember if you forget the rest.
